$comment: Example shot list produced in phase 3. Values are illustrative. Costs are filled in phase 4 from get_cost preflights, never typed by hand. Portrait ids are filled in phase 5 and first-frame ids in phase 6, once the user has approved them. Every take is animated from its first frame (start_image) with the portrait in the video model's identity role where it has one. The reference video is never an input, and the concept is new: it keeps the reference's mechanism, not its scenes.
why_it_works: Hook: a stranger's blunt question to camera. Tension: the viewer has been asked it too. Turn: a private moment where the product answers. Payoff: relief shown on the face, not claimed. CTA: one line, spoken, then written.

concept.chosen: A barista keeps getting the same question from regulars; on her break she tries the product and the next regular gets a different answer.
concept.alternative: Two friends on a video call, one still asking, the other already convinced.

design.type: Site heading font is an open-license geometric sans; used for captions and the end card in two weights
design.captions: brand text color, soft shadow, sentence case, bottom safe zone as the reference

cast.description: Woman in her late twenties, slim, shoulder-length curly dark hair, medium-light skin tone, mustard knit sweater, small gold hoop earrings, baseline expression patient and dry; the barista.

first_frame.description: Behind a cafe counter at morning light, the host (mustard knit sweater, curly dark hair, gold hoop earrings) mid-pour, eyes up at an unseen regular, patient half-smile.

shots.performance: Starts patient and amused; the turn is a tiny eye-roll on the second 'still'; ends dry and fond. Even pace, low volume, eyes to the regular off camera, hands keep pouring.
shots.visual: From the first frame: she finishes the pour, glances at the regular, answers without looking up, the smallest eye-roll, back to the cup.

first_frame.description: Back room on her break, the host (same sweater, hair, earrings) holding a slim can at eye level, skeptical eyebrow raised, soft window light.

shots.performance: Starts skeptical; the turn is the first sip, eyes widen; ends surprised and pleased, a short laugh at herself. Eyes on the can, then to camera on the last word.
shots.visual: From the first frame: she sips, pauses, looks at the can, then at the camera with a half-smile while speaking.

first_frame.description: The can on the cafe counter beside the espresso machine, condensation on it, morning light, shallow depth of field.

shots.performance: Calm and bright; no people; the product is the answer.
shots.visual: From the first frame: slow push in on the can, a drop of condensation runs down.

edit_plan: On-screen text over shot 1 at 1.0 to 2.5 s: 'Every. Single. Morning.' in the brand display style, accent on one word.
End card over shot 3, last 4 seconds: logo, brand name, tagline, 'Try grapefruit this week', the address; slow zoom on the still; brand ground color under the text.
Music bed music.wav (user-supplied) at -18 dB, ducked to -28 dB under speech.
Captions from the intended lines in the brand's type and color.
